name: diff-patch
title: Diff Patch
description: Reads and writes unified diffs: parsePatch turns `git diff`, `git show` or `diff -u` output into FileDiffs (multi-file patches, renames, copies, modes, new, deleted, binary, quoted paths), and formatHunks prints the diff engine's hunks back as a unified diff.
docs: `parsePatch(text)` reads `git diff`, `git show` or `diff -u` output into `FileDiff`s for `toViewFiles` and `DiffView` (`GitDiff` takes the text as `patch` and calls it for you). `formatHunks(hunks)` prints `diffText`'s hunks as a unified diff, for a `CodeBlock` in `diff` language or a file.
